summary: Verified Partner Registration Fee feature end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passing — admin can update fee settings, partner /fee reflects live (percentage 20% on ₹499 → ₹399.2, fixed ₹100 on ₹499 → ₹399), mock create-order/confirm marks fee as paid, inactive toggle sets enabled=false, and admin partner-reg kyc detail endpoint returns reg_fee_payment.status='paid' for target profile. Frontend: Integration Center card (intg-card-partner-reg-fee) shows 'Active · ₹399.2 ₹499'; Configure dialog (partner-reg-fee-dialog) opens with all required testids (prf-enabled/prf-original/prf-dtype-percentage/prf-dtype-fixed/prf-dvalue/prf-final/prf-save). Live recalculation verified: pct 20% → ₹399.2, fixed 100 → ₹399. Values persist after Save (reopen shows original=499, dvalue=20, enabled toggle checked, final=₹399.2). Approved KYC list → clicked kyc-open-<id> (Review) for partner f79db2be-e104-4980-9fd7-756a5609063e → kyc-detail dialog Registration Fee section shows kyc-fee-status='Paid', Amount Paid=₹399, Paid On timestamp, Transaction Ref=REGFEE-488d71ef-647, Gateway=mock · test.

integration_issues.issue: Review request said click 'Full Profile' (kyc-profile-<id>) to reach kyc-detail dialog, but that button opens Person360 (setViewUser). The kyc-detail dialog with the Registration Fee section is actually opened by the Review button (kyc-open-<id>). Not a bug — just a request-doc mismatch. Verified via kyc-open-<id> that Registration Fee section renders correctly.

action_items: Consider clarifying in feature docs that on approved-KYC list, the 'Review' button (kyc-open-<id>) opens the KycDetail dialog containing the Registration Fee section, not 'Full Profile' (kyc-profile-<id>) which opens Person360.
critical_code_review_comments: KycDetail Section 'Registration Fee' correctly gates 'Paid' details on status == 'paid'. Uses Math.round for amount display consistent with card and partner overlay.

Backend create-order returns HTTP 400 with detail 'Registration fee already paid' when partner already paid. This is correct idempotent behavior; frontend/tests should treat it as a non-error and fall through to /fee already_paid=true.
PartnerRegFeeCard status line renders '<original>' as strikethrough next to the discounted amount — verified visually as 'Active · ₹399.2 ₹499'.
